individualClassifications.message: Use equals() to compare object references.
individualClassifications.reason: SS314 requires exact borrowed repository owner identity. equals would admit another owner and cannot replace reference comparison. Null/wrong/same object vectors are explicit001.

individualClassifications.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
individualClassifications.reason: Standalone host Unit only, finite two-worker executor owned by try-with-resources and 10-second futures,40 iterations, no servlet container/backend work; tests cache stateless independent requests. No Product or server thread ownership changed.
